definitions.duration: observed endpoint differences only; incomplete and competing outcomes retained; no survival estimator
definitions.request_sec: exogenous ready_sec for each DRT-mode person, not confirmed acceptance timestamp
definitions.arrival_sec: terminal allocation time; DRT after alighting completion, not vehicle physical arrival
definitions.road: instantaneous snapshots; actor_snapshot_count is a repeated count, not unique actors or time integral
definitions.gate: only gate_applicable True rows counted as pass/reject; all others not_applicable
